remarks: RETRY OUTCOME: this retry did NOT improve on the original attempt. Same 3 verifiedSources (nsws.gov.in, csidc.in, dgfasli.gov.in) and the same 0 additional sources became verifiable. Every previously-excluded Chhattisgarh-specific domain (industries.cg.gov.in, invest.cg.gov.in, cglabour.nic.in, cglabour.gov.in, cgstate.gov.in, chips.gov.in, services.india.gov.in, egazette.gov.in, labour.gov.in state-list page, nsws.gov.in/portal/chhattisgarh, indiacode.nic.in) was individually re-tested this session with curl, and in some cases cross-checked with openssl/Python/legacy-TLS workarounds; all remain unverifiable as real, substantive sources, though the specific failure mode shifted for a few hosts (e.g. cgstate.gov.in moved from 'timeout' to 'reachable but HTTP 500'; cglabour.gov.in moved from 'timeout' to 'connection reset'; nsws.gov.in/portal/chhattisgarh moved from 'connection reset' to 'HTTP 200 empty SPA shell'). None of these shifts produced usable content.

This session's proxy status endpoint (http://127.0.0.1:46877/__agentproxy/status) shows, during this retry, concurrent relay failures ('ws_closed_mid_exchange', 'connect_unreachable') against a broad, unrelated set of other Indian state-government labour/industries domains (e.g. labour.kerala.gov.in, pblabour.gov.in, industries.kerala.gov.in, www.apindustries.gov.in, ipb.ap.gov.in, rajfab.rajasthan.gov.in, labour.assam.gov.in, shramsuvidha.gov.in) even while unrelated domains (dgfasli.gov.in, nsws.gov.in root, csidc.in) succeeded normally. This indicates the instability affecting Chhattisgarh-specific .cg.gov.in/.nic.in hosts is part of a broader, still-ongoing session/network condition affecting many Indian government domains generally, not something specific to CG that has since cleared.

For invest.cg.gov.in and egazette.gov.in specifically, this retry went further than the original attempt: it confirmed via curl -v that the failing TLS handshake is against the real destination's own certificate chain (not a proxy-re-termination issue), and separately confirmed the same failure independently in Python's ssl/urllib3 stack using both the session-provided CA bundle and the system CA bundle. A raw `openssl s_client` connection to the same hosts reports 'Verify return code: 0 (ok)', but since the spec specifies curl as the verification method and two independently-configured, standards-conformant HTTPS clients (curl, Python) both reject the chain, these two hosts are kept in `excluded` rather than being promoted on the strength of one differently-behaving tool.

No reachable, independently-verifiable copy of the Chhattisgarh Factories Rules, 1962 (or its later amendments) was found in this retry either — the primary official candidate sources for that text (a Chhattisgarh Labour Department site and egazette.gov.in) remain unreachable/unverifiable for the same reasons as the original attempt.

Several additional general Chhattisgarh state-portal domain guesses (cg.gov.in, chhattisgarh.gov.in, cggov.nic.in, makeinchhattisgarh.in, cgindustries.gov.in) were tried fresh in this retry as a broader net beyond the original attempt's candidate list; none resolved to usable content, so no new verified source resulted from the wider search either.
